synopsis.text:
I share similar interests with Miyoshi—a fellow female otaku—and, best of all, we both love dirty jokes. One day, while I was deep in a raunchy conversation with our mutual male friend, Maeda, the mood shifted completely when I spotted a condom that Miyoshi had accidentally dropped. Blushing, Miyoshi asked, "Wanna use it?" Caught off guard, I agreed, and we headed to a hotel—where I soon found myself hooked on the raw, visceral pleasure that a manga could never quite capture!

(Source: Lune-soft, translated)
